concerns.text: T009's smoke test 're-runs the thin pipeline and asserts all metric values in data/results/metrics_raw.csv match a stored reference' — but metrics_raw.csv is produced by T005 from the FULL pipeline (T004 outputs), not the thin run. The artifact-flow is ambiguous: either the thin run must write metrics to a separate file, or the comparison target must be the full-run metrics. As written, the consumer (T009) reads an artifact whose producer run does not match the re-executed pipeline.
